name: 해마 수조실
prompt: Create a high-end cinematic environment artwork for an educational fantasy escape-room game. Landscape 3:2, AAA realistic 3D game environment / film production rendering, physically plausible lighting, richly detailed materials, atmospheric perspective. Inspired by a moonlit Scottish gothic castle: cool dark teal-blue night light with warm golden lantern light. NOT an illustration, NOT vector, NOT cartoon, NOT low-poly. Beautiful and inviting for children without childish styling. No people, no creatures in the foreground, no text, no letters, no UI, no watermark. Keep the lower central foreground relatively open; interactive 3D props are placed in front later. Natural 40mm eye-level camera, horizon in the upper middle, subtle depth of field. SCENE: No people, no text, no UI, tall glass aquarium chamber with seahorses drifting among branching coral inside a bubbling tank, decorative shell mosaics tracing the wet stone floor, brass pipe fittings framing the glass, warm amber lantern reflections dancing on the water against cool teal moonlight from above, three-quarter interior view leaving generous open floor space, soft caustic light patterns, richly detailed fantasy concept art.
